newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest to issue DM 150 mln int'l bonds in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Budapest to issue DM 150 mln int'l bonds in 1998.

text.p: The city of Budapest is planning to issue 150 million marks worth of bonds on international markets, the first such issuance by a Hungarian municipality in years, Mayor Gabor Demszky said.
"Our plan is to issue 150 million Deutsche marks of bonds in 1998," Demszky told a news conference.
Demszky did not elaborate, other than saying the money raised would not be used for a new subway line, whose construction was announced at the same news conference. @
Late last year, the city's finance committee was reported to be considering the bond issue, adding that five-year, seven-year and nine-year maturities were being considered.
